authorize.title: Connect Obedience
authorize.description:
1. Open this link: {auth_url}

2. Approve Home Assistant in Obedience.

3. The page will show your extension ID, secret and user ID. Copy those values into the fields below.

Home Assistant only uses these credentials for outbound API requests. No webhook or inbound connection is required.

abort.already_configured: This Obedience connection is already configured.
abort.auth_failed: The Obedience authorization credentials are invalid or the authorization session expired.
